name: PhotoModel
description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Photo's window: the canvas as a CoreRaster PixelBuffer, its layer stack, selected layer and tool, adjustment settings, and inspector and Layer menu state; the free transform's handle hit and drag math adapt onto SuiteKernel (LiveTransform+Kernel); the canvas picture renders through CoreRender's dispatcher on a PhotoRenderRoute. Foundation only, value types.

relationships.description: declares document kinds and pasteboard representations; reads preferences
draws the canvas picture through RenderDispatcher (CPU backend or a preferred GPU backend)
